2609.08826.title: A Closed-Form Estimator and Diagnostic Battery for Anchor-Judge Error Correlation, Under a Single-Common-Factor Model
2609.08826.paper_summary: When an external reference set (an anchor) is used to decompose an LLM-judge panel's error into a quality signal and a shared common-mode error, standard practice assumes the anchor is uncontaminated: its error uncorrelated with the judges' shared error. We study when that assumption can be dropped and replaced by an estimate. Under a single-common-factor model, >=2 judges and >=2 anchors point-identify the quality variance, the common-mode variance, and each anchor's contamination correlation rho_k in closed form, with an exact per-anchor-pair failure boundary; a designated clean-anchor estimator, by contrast, reports a contaminated companion anchor as fully clean once its trusted anchor is itself contaminated. Because the single-common-factor assumption is itself untestable, the estimator ships gated behind a calibrated diagnostic battery (judge-covariance dispersion; over-identification; a family-block test from judge metadata, with a family-blocked estimator that removes family-level shared-residual bias exactly), bootstrap confidence intervals with measured coverage, and a weak-identification screen. A proposition maps which violations bias rho_k, in which direction, and which evade detection. For ordinal scores we show an identification hierarchy: with all variables ordinal, rho_k is not identified at any number of anchors; with ordinal judges and >=3 continuous anchors it is, and we give an estimator for that case. On real data the validation is asymmetric, and we say so plainly: the diagnostics are validated in the rejecting direction (both real panels we test are correctly rejected by the model-adequacy pre-test), while the estimator is validated in simulation and stress-tested semi-synthetically under oracle calibration; no real panel has yet passed the pre-test, and the pre-test exists precisely to say so. All results replay offline from shipped, checksummed artifacts.
2609.08826.paper_summary_zh: 當使用外部參考集（錨點）來將LLM-評審小組的錯誤分解為質量信號和共享共模錯誤時，標準做法假設錨點未受到污染：其錯誤與評審的共享錯誤不相關。我們研究何時可以放棄該假設並用估計值替代。在單一共因子模型下，>=2名評審和>=2個錨點以封閉形式精確識別質量方差、共模方差，以及每個錨點的污染相關性rho_k，並提供每對錨點的精確失敗邊界；相比之下，指定的乾淨錨點估計器在其可信的錨點本身受到污染後，將污染的伴隨錨點報告為完全乾淨。由於單一共因子假設本身無法檢驗，因此該估計器必須通過一組經過校準的診斷測試（評審協方差擴散；過度識別；來自評審元數據的家庭區塊測試，帶有精確消除家庭層級共享殘差偏差的家庭區塊估計器）、具有測量覆蓋率的自助信心區間，以及弱識別篩選來進行檢驗。一個命題映射了哪些違規會偏倚rho_k，方向為何，以及哪些逃避檢測。對於序數分數，我們展示了一個識別層級：當所有變數為序數時，rho_k在任何數量的錨點下都無法識別；當評審為序數且>=3個連續錨點時則可以識別，我們為該情況提供了一個估計器。在真實數據中，驗證是不對稱的，我們明確指出：診斷在拒絕方向上得到了驗證（我們測試的兩個真實小組都被模型適合性預檢正確拒絕），而估計器在模擬中得到了驗證，並在預言者校準下進行了半合成的壓力測試；至今沒有真實小組通過預檢，而預檢的存在恰恰是為了說明這一點。所有結果都從發送的、經檢查和校驗的文檔中離線重播。
2609.08826.author: Veerendra Kumar Sunkavalli et.al.
